(Bronze, Silver and Gold), students can 
progress through these ranks by 
achieving certain milestones. 
Achievements: 
1. Flawless – get all questions correct 
in a lesson. 
2. Completed lessons – a count of the 
number of new lessons completed. 
3. Gems – number of gems earned 
over the user’s lifetime. 
4. First place – finish first place at the 
end of the week on the leader 
board. 
5. Speedster – complete a new 
lesson in under a minute. 
6. Revision – Number of revised 
lessons completed, that are 
highlighted by the spaced 
repetition manager.  
 
Outcome: Encourages precision, efficiency 
and motivation.
